title: harness: failing checks are reported and make the exit status 1
purpose: Negative control: a broken assertion mechanism must not turn into silent success.

stdout.text:
not ok 1 - int mismatch: expected 5, got 4
not ok 2 - text mismatch: expected "abd", got "abc"
not ok 3 - bool mismatch: expected true, got false
not ok 4 - false condition: condition is false
not ok 5 - array mismatch: expected [2, 1], got [1, 2]
not ok 6 - explicit failure: unreachable branch
ok 7 - still counted
checks: 7, failed: 6

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: harness contract: failing checks print 'not ok N - label: detail' and done() returns 1; values follow spec 8.3/8.4 (2+2=4, arrays compare by order).
